versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.

ai-image-realism v0.2.6

- Expanded and clarified documentation describing the editing workflow, key priorities (such as preservation of identity and branding), and decision points for repairing AI-generated image artifacts.
- Outlines must-keep elements, confirmation needs, edit region logic, and revision flows.
- Details best practices for handling plastic skin, malformed hands, repeated textures, and other common issues.
- Documents safe automatic updates and bundled client usage.
- Adds a comprehensive reference section for troubleshooting, task management, and recovery.
